goal:
Create the ShredWidth CMake scaffold and JUCE pin. This task is the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt in phase A.

Before editing, inspect:
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/CMakeLists.txt (structure, juce_add_plugin fields, LV2)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/.gitmodules and JUCE tag (git -C JUCE describe --tags → 8.0.13 / 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/CMakeLists.txt (nSpace conventions: COMPANY_NAME, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, BUNDLE_ID, LV2URI, CXX20, configure-only option, JUCE presence check)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/CMakePresets.json
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§10, 13, 15

Implement:
1. CMakeLists.txt:
   - cmake_minimum_required 3.22; project(ShredWidth VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX); C++20 required.
   - option SHREDWIDTH_CONFIGURE_ONLY (return early without JUCE).
   - FATAL_ERROR if JUCE/CMakeLists.txt missing when not configure-only.
   - add_subdirectory(JUCE).
   - juce_add_plugin(ShredWidth): PRODUCT_NAME ShredWidth, COMPANY_NAME "nSpace Systems", VERSION 1.0.0, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, PLUGIN_CODE ShWd, BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shredwidth, LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredwidth, FORMATS VST3 CLAP LV2 Standalone (no AU), IS_SYNTH FALSE, NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE, COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE or match aural-maximizer-pro/shredboost practice.
   - Wire CLAP via clap-juce-extensions if available as submodule path clap-juce-extensions; if submodule not present, document the expected add_subdirectory + clap_juce_extensions_plugin call and include conditional integration so configure still works once the submodule exists.
   - target_sources PRIVATE minimal stubs: Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, Source/PluginEditor.cpp (files may be created empty/minimal by this task only if needed for configure; prefer listing paths that a.2/a.3 will fill).
   - target_compile_definitions: JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0, JUCE_USE_CURL=0, JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0, and SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER cache/option default 2 (expose as compile definition).
   - link juce::juce_audio_utils, juce::juce_dsp, recommended config/lto/warning flags like shredboost.
   - enable_testing() scaffold (no heavy tests yet).
2. CMakePresets.json: version 3, configure/build/test presets for linux-relwithdebinfo (or linux-release) with binaryDir under build/.
3. scripts/build_all.sh: set -euo pipefail; resolve cmake when not on PATH by searching CLion bundled locations (e.g. $HOME/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/*/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake, /opt/clion/*/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake, common CLion snap/flatpak paths); fall back to cmake on PATH; configure with preset; build all format targets.
4. JUCE submodule: write/update .gitmodules entry path=JUCE url=https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git; pin to the same commit/tag as aural-maximizer-pro (8.0.13 / 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2). Prefer git submodule add/update; if JUCE already exists via symlink on this machine, keep/ensure submodule metadata matches the pin and do not vendor a second copy.

Do not implement ParameterIDs, APVTS, StateManager, or editor UI logic here.
